result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): The two layouts are close to identical: the same grouping (Listening, Downloads & Alerts, Display), sensible defaults and suitable controls. A wins narrowly because it says up front that changes save automatically on this device, which covers the save-feedback item; B shows nothing about whether changes are kept. B's crossfade control is cleaner, since A's slider sits mid-track while the switch says Off. Neither screenshot shows the reset option, so item 4 is scored low and equal for both. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots use nearly the same grouping, with listening settings first, then downloads and alerts, then display. Every value is visible in both, and both use suitable switches, segmented controls and selects. B says outright that "Changes save automatically on this device," which settles the saved-or-unsaved question; A gives no such cue. B's crossfade is a little awkward, though: the slider is greyed out but still shows a position while the label reads "Off," and one segment of its quality control is taller than the others. The reset option is cut off in both screenshots, so item 4 is a neutral guess for each.
